trending_videos.title: Southern Charm | Season 12 Official Trailer (Bravo, 2026)
trending_videos.description:
'Southern Charm' is back, with returning Charmers Venita Aspen, Salley Carson, Craig Conover, Austen Kroll, Madison LeCroy, Molly O’Connell, Rodrigo Reyes, Whitner Slagsvol and Shep Rose, plus one new face: Allie Newman, a Charleston-based model, friend of Venita’s and former flame of Austen! After a reunion where the status of friendships and situationships remained ambiguous, the Holy City crew is determined to define their relationships and mend wounds. However, when true feelings bubble up and juicy rumors catch fire (a secret love child?!), the group seeks to unveil the truth... even if it costs them more than just friendships. Fan-favorite Patricia Altschul and her son, Whitney-Sudler Smith, as well as Charley Manley and Shep's ex, Taylor Ann Green, are set for season 12, as well, which premieres on Thursday, Nov. 12, at 9 p.m. ET/PT on Bravo. Episodes stream next day on Peacock.


More from Entertainment Tonight: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCdtXPiqI2cLorKaPrfpKc4g?sub_confi

trending_videos.title: GRIEF (VERIFIED) // TOP 1
trending_videos.description:
One level. 2 years, 436K attempts, ~600 hours of playtime, and a dream.

Icedcave first approached me with the concept of GRIEF in 2021, when Slaughterhouse was the brand new #1 demon. GRIEF was his final attempt at giving life to the level that launched his name into the community back in 2015 - Old Slaughterhouse. I saw what he was doing, I saw his vision and passion, and I knew this would be something big. I had always wanted to verify the hardest level in GD, and once I laid eyes on GRIEF I knew this was the one. I asked Icedcave for permission to verify it, and thankfully he accepted. 

Over the next 2 years, I followed the building process of GRIEF, going from a layout that garnered tons of hate, to the final showcase which became the beloved level we all recognize today. Every step of the way, this verification was something to look forward to in my career - until it wasn't.
